text:
ethan: Hey all — made a Notion onboarding page for QA interns and want it to auto-assign mentors when a new hire uses it. Is that a thing or do we just add an 'Assigned mentor' field manually?

devex-bot: Quick note: Notion doesn't have native auto-assign by template. Common pattern: add a 'Mentor' property in the onboarding DB (person property) and workflows use a tiny automation to set it. See internal guide: https://redwood.docs/notion-automations

maria: We use a Zapier/Workflow that listens for new DB entries and sets Mentor based on Team tag. Flow: when new row created -> lookup on Team mapping -> set Person field -> post welcome message to #new-hires with mentor mention.

ethan: Is that open for anyone to hook up or do I need infra/devex help?

jo: We have a shared Automation user and a template mapping sheet (Google). If you want the mapping updated (e.g., QA -> @beth), file a tiny request: https://redwood.workflows/automation-add and include: DB link, template name, team tag, mentor handle. We'll run it.

beth: FYI for mentors: we prefer not to be auto-assigned for contractors. Add an Audience frontmatter line in the page and we keep contractors opt-in. Example frontmatter block we use at top of page (plain text):
Owner: ethan
Role: QA Intern
Audience: NewHire
AssignMentor: team-qa
Tags: onboarding, qa

ethan: Nice — should I put the page in Product > Onboarding DB or Product > Team Drafts while we test?

maria: Put a copy in Product > Team Drafts first. Add the frontmatter and suffix the title with [WIP]. Once automation mapping is ready we move the canonical into the Onboarding DB.

ethan: If we want the new-hire welcome message in Slack to include a link and a checklist summary, how do we surface the checklist items?

jo: We include a short summary field in the DB called 'Slack Summary' (text). The automation reads that to post into #new-hires. For checklists we recommend a 3-line summary rather than dumping the whole page.

maria: Also add 'add-to-digest' tag if you want it considered by the weekly New Hire Digest.

ethan: Great. I'll move a copy to Team Drafts, add the frontmatter, set AssignMentor: team-qa, and submit the automation-add request. Thanks! :rocket:
